machinelearning.regression_evaluation
=====================================

.. py:module:: machinelearning.regression_evaluation

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   This module implements grouped nested cross-validation for regression
   tasks, including model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation
   metrics.
   It supports multiple regression models.
   Choosing the model and its hyperparameters is done solely using
   train + validation sets. The test set is only used for final
   evaluation of the best (refitted to train+validation) model.

.. py:data:: INCLUDE_MODELS_THAT_TAKE_LONG_TIME
   :value: False


.. py:function:: regression_metrics(y_true: numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series, y_pred: numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series) -> dict[str, float]

   Compute common regression metrics for predictions.

   :param y_true: Ground-truth target values.
   :type y_true: np.ndarray | pd.Series
   :param y_pred: Predicted target values.
   :type y_pred: np.ndarray | pd.Series

   :returns: Dictionary with RMSE, MAE, and R2 values.
   :rtype: dict[str, float]


.. py:function:: nested_cv_grouped(df: pandas.DataFrame, target_col: str, group_col: str = 'participant_id', outer_splits: int = 5, inner_splits: int = 3) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Run grouped nested cross-validation across candidate regressors.

   The outer GroupKFold estimates generalization performance, while
   the inner GroupKFold tunes hyperparameters with GridSearchCV.

   :param df: Input dataframe containing features, target, and group column.
   :type df: pd.DataFrame
   :param target_col: Name of the target column.
   :type target_col: str
   :param group_col: Name of the grouping column used to avoid leakage across folds.
   :type group_col: str, optional
   :param outer_splits: Number of outer CV folds.
   :type outer_splits: int, optional
   :param inner_splits: Number of inner CV folds.
   :type inner_splits: int, optional

   :returns: Aggregated metrics per model, sorted by mean RMSE.
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: old_choose_feature_modalities(df: pandas.DataFrame, modalities: list, always_keep=['GLC', 'participant_id'])

   Keep only feature columns matching selected modality prefixes.

   :param df: Input dataframe with feature and metadata columns.
   :type df: pd.DataFrame
   :param modalities: Prefixes used to select feature columns (e.g., ["ppg_", "ecg_"]).
   :type modalities: list
   :param always_keep: Columns that should be preserved even if they do not match a prefix.
   :type always_keep: list, optional

   :returns: Filtered dataframe with selected feature columns.
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: remove_metadata_columns_but_id_and_glc(df: pandas.DataFrame, datasetConfig: datasets_util.naming_conventions.DatasetConfig) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Drop non-feature metadata columns while keeping grouping
   information (participant_id) and target (GLC).

   :param df: Input dataframe.
   :type df: pd.DataFrame

   :returns: Dataframe without session and datetime columns.
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: train_with_train_validation_sets(results: pandas.DataFrame, train_df: pandas.DataFrame, target_col: str, inner_splits: int = 3) -> tuple[sklearn.base.BaseEstimator, str]

   Refit the best model from nested CV on train+validation data.

   :param results: Nested CV summary where the top row contains the best model name.
   :type results: pd.DataFrame
   :param train_df: Combined training and validation dataframe.
   :type train_df: pd.DataFrame
   :param target_col: Name of the target column.
   :type target_col: str
   :param inner_splits: Number of grouped folds used for the refit GridSearchCV.
   :type inner_splits: int, optional

   :returns: Best estimator fitted on the full train+validation set.
   :rtype: BaseEstimator


.. py:function:: regression_evaluation(datasetConfig: datasets_util.naming_conventions.DatasetConfig) -> None

   Execute the end-to-end grouped regression evaluation workflow.

   This routine loads train/validation/test splits organized as
   CSV files with features, selects feature
   modalities, performs grouped nested cross-validation, refits the
   best model on train+validation data, evaluates on test data, and
   reports a dummy baseline for comparison.

   :param modalities: Feature prefixes to include in the evaluation.
   :type modalities: list[str]
